task_name: Check completeness, gaps, risks and review readiness
output_text: {"gaps":[{"gap_id":"GAP_001","missing_information":"Explicit interface definitions between microscope workstation, software application, client application, live image stream, and control request are not provided.","why_it_matters":"Without interfaces, downstream model generation cannot reliably define connectors, ports, APIs, or interaction boundaries.","suggested_human_action":"Confirm which elements communicate directly and whether any protocol, API, or connection details should be modeled."},{"gap_id":"GAP_002","missing_information":"The relationship between 'software application' and 'client application' is not explicitly defined.","why_it_matters":"This affects logical and physical decomposition and may change whether these are separate components or alternate names for the same application.","suggested_human_action":"Ask the source owner to clarify whether these are distinct elements or one element described two ways."},{"gap_id":"GAP_003","missing_information":"The structure and fields of 'basic session information' are not specified.","why_it_matters":"Traceability/data models cannot be generated precisely without knowing what session data must be recorded.","suggested_human_action":"Request a list of required session fields and any storage/retention expectations."},{"gap_id":"GAP_004","missing_information":"Validation, test criteria, and acceptance thresholds are absent.","why_it_matters":"Verification models and acceptance-related model artifacts are blocked without evidence of how requirements are checked.","suggested_human_action":"Provide explicit validation or acceptance criteria for the system requirements."}],"ambiguities_and_risks":[{"risk_id":"RISK_001","topic":"Control transfer behavior","description":"The source states control requires operator acceptance, but does not define timing, state transitions, or what happens if control is revoked or contested.","potential_impact":"Control-state behavior may be modeled inconsistently or too loosely for review.","suggested_review_action":"Review and clarify the control transfer sequence, including transition timing and edge cases."},{"risk_id":"RISK_002","topic":"Remote adjustment scope","description":"'Adjust the microscope view remotely' is stated, but the specific controls and limits are not defined.","potential_impact":"Functional scope may be overgeneralized or under-modeled.","suggested_review_action":"Confirm which microscope actions are in scope for remote control."},{"risk_id":"RISK_003","topic":"Deployment and ownership","description":"The description mentions workstation and application elements, but does not describe deployment topology or component ownership.","potential_impact":"Physical architecture modeling remains preliminary and may be speculative if elevated too early.","suggested_review_action":"Keep physical architecture at preliminary level until deployment context is clarified."},{"risk_id":"RISK_004","topic":"Traceability record content","description":"The requirement to record session information is explicit, but the traceability purpose is not backed by a defined record schema or retention policy.","potential_impact":"A data/artifact model could be incomplete or inaccurate.","suggested_review_action":"Confirm what traceability data must be preserved and for how long."}],"review_questions":[{"question_id":"RQ_001","question":"Are the software application and client application separate system elements, or are they two informal names for the same application?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"SRC_INFO_005, SRC_INFO_007, ELEM_017, ELEM_018","reason":"This determines component decomposition and interface interpretation."},{"question_id":"RQ_002","question":"What are the explicit interfaces, protocols, and data exchanges between the microscope workstation, software application, client application, and session/control data?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"SRC_INFO_016, MISS_001","reason":"Interfaces are needed for logical and physical architecture modeling."},{"question_id":"RQ_003","question":"What information is included in 'basic session information', and where is it stored?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"SRC_INFO_013, ELEM_012, ELEM_015","reason":"This is required to define the data/artifact and traceability aspects."},{"question_id":"RQ_004","question":"What is the exact control-transfer workflow after the operator accepts a request, including state changes and timing?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"SRC_INFO_009, SRC_INFO_011, AMB_004","reason":"The control state behavior is currently underspecified."},{"question_id":"RQ_005","question":"How will the requirements for simultaneous control prevention, current control visibility, and session recording be verified or accepted?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"SRC_INFO_011, SRC_INFO_012, SRC_INFO_013, MISS_004","reason":"Verification cannot be derived without acceptance criteria or test evidence."}],"recommended_review_decision":"incomplete_but_reviewable"}
